runs.content:
**Investigation idea:** The actual tool behind Learning's "Ideal Lifestyle Costing" exercise has been sitting untouched since ingestion — the page still runs on a made-up example number. raw/learning/Monthly Expense Calculator.md (the companion tool Ferriss built for the exact same dreamlining exercise, tagged ingested on 2026-04-26) has never been opened or referenced anywhere in the wiki. learning/source-ferriss-ideal-lifestyle-costing.md's own Fred's Takeaways section admits the gap implicitly: "if the ideal lifestyle costs $8K/month, the portfolio needs to generate $96K/year" is explicitly hypothetical, not a number Fred has actually run through the calculator — and no Finance page carries any income target either, hypothetical or real, so this number currently exists nowhere in the wiki. Next step: work through the actual calculator with Fred, replace the hypothetical in source-ferriss-ideal-lifestyle-costing.md's Takeaways with his real number, and consider whether portfolio-overview.md should carry it as a stated income target.

**Cross-domain connection:** Health's own dementia-prevention research names the exact game genres it considers protective, and Fred is literally building games — the two pages have never met. health/source-wood-brain-sharp-2026.md's "Cognitive Stimulation / Processing Speed Training" section is explicit: "Video games count: Super Mario, StarCraft-style real-time strategy," backed by a 20-year study showing processing-speed training reduces dementia risk, broadening out to "novel learning" generally. games/overview.md and games/prototypes.md are both still placeholder stubs, but Fred already has two real prototype concepts in raw/games/ (a casual arcade/reflex game and a strategy-adjacent Children's Financial Literacy Game), plus health/my-protocol.md's own "Processing speed games are literally part of the protocol — not just fun" line has never been carried through to my-protocol.md's still-empty tables. Building games isn't just a hobby project sitting in its own domain — by Health's own cited research it's a plausible protective activity for the exact "men ~50" cognitive-decline risk the domain exists to address. Next step: add a line to my-protocol.md's cognitive-stimulation section citing game-building/playing as a Wood-sourced intervention, cross-linked to games/overview.md.

Wednesday focus (Health + Learning): deep-read health/overview.md, health/my-protocol.md, both Health source pages, learning/overview.md, learning/courses.md, and person-seth-godin.md, cross-checked memory/index.md's Domain Content Status and Open Threads, and reviewed raw/health/ and raw/learning/ folder contents directly against what's actually referenced in the wiki (which surfaced the unused expense-calculator gap). Neither domain has had new content ingested since 2026-05-15, and log.md showed no Health/Learning activity since the last thinker run (2026-07-28) — both findings above came from re-reading existing material with fresh eyes rather than new source ingestion.

**Investigation idea:** AI & Tech's own overview page has two stale sections that current wiki + tooling state has already answered, but the page (last touched 2026-05-01) has never been updated to say so. ai-tech/AI & Tech overview.md's "Future Ideas" section still lists an open todo for an "Email → Clippings pipeline — install an email MCP... to monitor a specific label/folder" — but that pipeline already exists and has been running successfully since 2026-07-12 (the email-to-clipping skill, reading from botfred47@gmail.com, has processed clippings on at least 6 separate dates through 2026-07-27 per log.md, most recently the DealBook Google-capex briefing). The same page's "Active Tools & Stack" table is also still 100% "[to be added]" placeholders, even though memory/index.md's Environment and Active MCPs tables already document the real stack in full (Pandoc, Node.js, pdfjs-dist, Word COM; 5 named MCPs — crypto-market-data, massive, mcp-registry, excalidraw, fred-wiki). Next step: update AI & Tech overview.md — replace the email-pipeline todo with a note on what's actually built, and populate Active Tools & Stack directly from memory/index.md.

**Cross-domain connection:** AMD just became a party to the same circular-financing pattern Finance has spent months building a case against for CoreWeave — and AMD's own idea page doesn't mention it. This week's DealBook capex briefing (finance/source-nyt-dealbook-google-capex-2026-07-23.md, ingested 2026-07-27) reports Anthropic agreeing to buy up to 2GW of AMD chips, with AMD investing up to $5B into Anthropic in return — a vendor-financing-its-own-customer structure functionally identical to what finance/ideas/idea-crwv.md already documents in detail for CoreWeave (Meta's $19.2B backlog collateralising an $8.5B CoreWeave debt facility, described in that page's own words as "circular but structurally sound"). finance/ideas/idea-amd.md (last updated 2026-06-27, a month before this deal) lists Microsoft Azure, Meta, Oracle, and Hugging Face in its Key Customers table — no Anthropic row, and no mention anywhere of AMD extending capital to a customer. Arguably sharper than CoreWeave's case: AMD isn't merely selling into a circularly-financed ecosystem, it's writing the equity check itself — the exact mechanism Michael Burry's newest short thesis argues will define AI-era revenue quality. Next step: add Anthropic to idea-amd.md's Key Customers table with deal terms, and a Key Risks line citing the circular-financing concern already worked out in idea-crwv.md.

Tuesday focus (AI & Tech + Technology): read AI & Tech overview.md and technology/overview.md in full, cross-checked memory/index.md's Domain Content Status and Open Threads sections, and reviewed everything logged since the last thinker run (2026-07-27) — a batch of Burry Palantir/trading-post ingests and the NYT DealBook capex briefing, all already heavily reverse-linked by clippings-sorter's automatic cross-linking. Both findings above surfaced from checking what that automatic linking pass missed: a stale future-ideas todo nobody revisited, and a brand-new deal (Anthropic-AMD) that landed in a Finance source page but never made it back to AI & Tech's own AMD idea page.
